title: Netflix Brings New Series and Movies for the Weekend
seoTitle: Netflix: New Series & Movies Arrive This Weekend
subtitle: What's Trending on the Platform Right Now
excerpt: Netflix is buzzing with new releases this September weekend, featuring series premieres like "The Gentlemen: Season 2" and "Earle Meets World," plus fresh films.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
This September weekend, Netflix is rolling out a slate of new productions already generating buzz among subscribers. The platform kicks off with the second season of Guy Ritchie's "The Gentlemen," followed by the premiere of Alix Earle's reality show, "Earle Meets World," in addition to films and documentaries arriving in various catalogs.

What's New for Your Binge-Watching Schedule

With the arrival of "The Gentlemen" season two, Theo James returns as Eddie Horniman, now more deeply immersed in the world of cannabis trafficking and confronting Italian organized crime. The new season introduces new characters, such as Hugh Bonneville and Maya Jama, and already has a third season confirmed.

Earle Meets World: The Internet Star's Life in Focus

Alix Earle, known for her TikTok "Get Ready with Me" videos, expands her universe with an eight-episode series showcasing the influencer's routine, her family relationships, and her romance with athlete Braxton Berrios. The production features appearances by Earle's family members, including her sister Ashtin and father TJ.

New Films and Documentaries in the Catalog

  • "Untold Raygun: Breaking Badly," which revisits the journey of Rachael "Raygun" Gunn and the controversy surrounding the Paris Olympics.
  • "Scary Movie 6," the sixth installment of the horror parody franchise that satirizes titles like "Sinners" and "M3GAN."
  • "Parasomnia," directed by James Ross II, which blends horror with elements of psychological drama.
  • The documentary "Turning Point: Generation 9/11," which analyzes the impacts of the 2001 attacks 25 years later.

How to Enjoy the New Offerings

For those looking for something new to watch, Netflix provides recommendation guides by genre, such as comedy, thriller, and horror. The platform also offers exclusive content that might be found on other networks, but is now arriving on streaming this September, like Alix Earle's series and the film "Scary Movie 6."

What's Trending Now

The combination of action series, reality shows, and horror film releases creates an appealing mix for various audiences. The presence of well-known personalities like Theo James and Alix Earle, along with large-scale productions such as "Scary Movie 6," contributes to the current buzz.
